sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the story of Operation Spider's Web.
sentences.zh: 今天，讲述“蜘蛛网行动”的故事。

sentences.en: An audacious sneak attack by Ukraine that caused billions of dollars in damage to Russian warplanes with drones that cost as little as $600.
sentences.zh: 这是一次由乌克兰发起的惊人偷袭，用成本仅600美元的无人机对俄罗斯战机造成了数十亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: My colleague Mark Santora explains why this strike is already being seen as a defining moment in the evolution of modern warfare.
sentences.zh: 我的同事马克·桑托拉将解释为什么这次打击已被视为现代战争演变中的决定性时刻。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月4日，星期三。

sentences.en: Mark, we're coming to you because you are one of the correspondents who has been on the ground for the longest in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 马克，我们找你是因为你是乌克兰驻地时间最长的记者之一。

sentences.en: You've been reporting from the front lines, embedding with the Ukrainian military.
sentences.zh: 你一直在前线报道，并随乌克兰军队深入一线。

sentences.en: And we now know what happened this past Sunday was unlike anything we have seen so far in this war.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，上周日发生的事情与我们在这场战争中迄今所见的一切都不同。

sentences.en: You and a team of reporters have been working to uncover exactly what went down, how it went down, and I want to get to those specifics here today.
sentences.zh: 你和一组记者一直在努力揭开到底发生了什么，它是如何发生的，今天我想在这里了解这些细节。

sentences.en: But first, can you just take us through the events as you experience them on Sunday?
sentences.zh: 但首先，你能带我们回顾一下你周日亲历的事件吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So, you know, you get used to a lot of reports of explosions every day here, whether it's here in Ukraine or something going on in Russia.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这里，无论是乌克兰境内还是俄罗斯发生的事情，你对每天关于爆炸的报道都已经习以为常了。

sentences.en: But on Sunday, around 1 o'clock, we started to get these really strange reports of explosions at airfields 3,000 miles from Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但在周日一点左右，我们开始收到一些非常奇怪的报道，说距离乌克兰3000英里外的机场发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: First, we saw reports of explosions at an airfield all the way in Siberia.
sentences.zh: 起初，我们看到报道说远在西伯利亚的一个机场发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: And as they started to come in, we started to get videos of how these attacks were being conducted.
sentences.zh: 随着消息传来，我们开始收到这些袭击是如何进行的视频。

sentences.en: And it was really weird looking, right?
sentences.zh: 看起来真的很诡异，对吧？

sentences.en: Because, you know, we're used to long-range Ukrainian drone strikes going after, you know, Russian targets inside of Russia.
sentences.zh: 因为我们习惯了乌克兰的远程无人机打击俄罗斯境内的目标。

sentences.en: But here, we saw these trucks parked on the side of the road and then these small little quadcopters rising up from the trailer and taking off
sentences.zh: 但在这里，我们看到这些卡车停在路边，然后这些小型四轴无人机从拖车上升起并起飞，

sentences.en: and then, you know, cut images to burning planes and airfields.
sentences.zh: 然后，画面切换到燃烧的飞机和机场。

sentences.en: And so it quickly became apparent that in terms of how this strike was executed, in terms of its ambition, in terms of what it might mean for the war going forward,
sentences.zh: 所以很快就很明显，就这次打击的执行方式、野心以及它对未来战争的意义而言，

sentences.en: that this was something different.
sentences.zh: 这确实是与众不同的。

sentences.en: This was a signal event in this war.
sentences.zh: 这是这场战争中的标志性事件。

sentences.en: Okay, so a very big deal attack carried out in what seems to be a pretty sophisticated way.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是一次非常重大的袭击，而且是以一种看起来相当复杂的方式进行的。

sentences.en: How did this happen, Mark?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的，马克？

sentences.en: How did Ukraine pull this off?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Well, this is Ukraine's answer to a problem that has bedeviled them throughout this war, which is how do you stop massive, long-range Russian missile bombardments?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是乌克兰对困扰他们整个战争的问题的回答，那就是：你如何阻止大规模、远程的俄罗斯导弹轰炸？

sentences.en: And these are launched from planes flying deep in Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 这些导弹是从深入俄罗斯领土飞行的飞机上发射的。

sentences.en: They're missiles fired from ships and submarines out at sea, from land-based systems far inside of Russia.
sentences.zh: 它们是从海上的舰船和潜艇上，以及俄罗斯境内深处的陆基系统发射的导弹。

sentences.en: So basically out of the reach of the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是在乌克兰人的打击范围之外。

sentences.en: And these bombardments have become so routine in Ukraine that people can actually time when they want to go to the shelter by what's happening.
sentences.zh: 这些轰炸在乌克兰已经变得如此常规，以至于人们甚至可以根据正在发生的事情来计算何时去避难所。

sentences.en: For instance, a Russian bomber will take off from an airbase deep in Russia.
sentences.zh: 例如，一架俄罗斯轰炸机将从俄罗斯深处的一个空军基地起飞。

sentences.en: And you'll get a warning saying that the bombers are at the starting line.
sentences.zh: 你会收到警告说轰炸机已经在起飞线上了。

sentences.en: A warning, like, on your phone?
sentences.zh: 警告，比如在手机上？

sentences.en: Yeah, a warning on your phone.
sentences.zh: 是的，手机上的警告。

sentences.en: It'll say, Russian bombers, TU-95 at the starting line.
sentences.zh: 它会说，俄罗斯图-95轰炸机在起飞线上。

sentences.en: So that means you have about two hours until they get to the launch point.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你还有大约两个小时的时间，直到它们到达发射点。

sentences.en: You'll get an alarm.
sentences.zh: 你会收到警报。

sentences.en: Missiles have been launched.
sentences.zh: 导弹已经发射。

sentences.en: Then you know if you're in Kiev, say, and depending on where the launch is from, you know you have two, three hours for a cruise missile.
sentences.zh: 然后如果你在基辅，根据发射地点，你知道巡航导弹还有两三个小时到达。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's like a countdown to an attack on your phone live.
sentences.zh: 这就像手机上直播的袭击倒计时。

sentences.en: Yeah, so these bombers, everyone in Ukraine is intimately familiar with now, the TU-95, and it's kind of gone in waves in the war.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这些轰炸机，乌克兰的每个人现在都非常熟悉了，图-95，它在战争中是一波接一波的。

sentences.en: The more U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们得到的美国支持越多，比如爱国者导弹和其他东西，一些城市的人们就感到越安全。

sentences.en: support they got with Patriot missiles and other things, the more secure people in some cities felt.
sentences.zh: 随着美国支持的减弱，那种安全感也随之减弱，因为真正先进的武器系统很少，

sentences.en: As American support has faded, some of that feeling of security has faded with it because there's only a few really advanced weapon systems
sentences.zh: 能够对付俄罗斯最先进的导弹的系统很少。

sentences.en: that can go after Russia's most advanced missiles.
sentences.zh: 而乌克兰从来没有足够的数量。

sentences.en: And Ukraine never had enough of them.
sentences.zh: 但随着美国的撤退，他们拥有的就更少了。

sentences.en: But as America pulls back, they have even less.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来乌克兰政府看到了这个问题并说，

sentences.en: So it sounds like the Ukrainian government looks at this problem and says,
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是我们需要解决的问题。

sentences.en: OK, this is what we need to solve.
sentences.zh: 我们如何阻止这些俄罗斯轰炸机的远程导弹袭击？

sentences.en: How do we stop these long-range missile attacks from these Russian bombers?
sentences.zh: 百分之百。
所以乌克兰人做了他们整个战争期间一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: So the Ukrainians do what they've done throughout this war.
sentences.zh: 他们必须适应。

sentences.en: They have to adapt.
sentences.zh: 他们必须创新。

sentences.en: They have to innovate.
sentences.zh: 他们必须找到低成本的解决方案。

sentences.en: They have to find a low-cost solution.
sentences.zh: 于是他们转向了无人机。

sentences.en: And so what they do is they turn to drones.
sentences.zh: 无人机是乌克兰在这场战争中一次又一次求助于的东西，以在面对数量占优、拥有庞大军火库的敌人时生存下来。

sentences.en: Drones are the things that Ukraine has turned to time and again in this war to survive against an enemy that outnumbers them, that has a vastly bigger arsenal.
sentences.zh: 说实话，真的很难想象如果没有无人机，乌克兰会如何生存。

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, it's kind of hard to imagine how Ukraine would have survived without drones.
sentences.zh: 而且，过去三年去前线，你已经看到了它们是如何改变战场的。

sentences.en: And, you know, going to the front line over the last three years, you've just seen how they've transformed the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在每次我们和乌克兰人一起去前线阵地，都会有人坐在前座拿着霰弹枪，

sentences.en: I mean, every time now if we go out to a front-line position with the Ukrainians, you have someone riding on the front seat with a shotgun
sentences.zh: 因为这确实是对付某些小型无人机的唯一防御手段之一。

sentences.en: because, really, that's one of the only defenses against some of these kinds of smaller drones.
sentences.zh: 所以他们能够利用这些无人机以比平时更少的人力守住防御阵地。

sentences.en: So they're able to use these drones to hold defensive positions with fewer people than they might otherwise need.
sentences.zh: 但是，马克，这种策略虽然在前线成功，但它是如何解决我们刚才谈到的那个根本问题的呢？

sentences.en: But, Mark, how does this strategy, while successful on the front lines, get at that original problem we were talking about,
sentences.zh: 也就是在俄罗斯领土上打击俄罗斯的痛处，击中这些轰炸机？

sentences.en: which is striking Russia where it hurts in Russian territory, hitting these bombers?
sentences.zh: 首先，你知道，前线的所有这些人，每天都在看着俄罗斯的导弹和炸弹袭击他们家人居住的城镇和城市。

sentences.en: So, first of all, you know, all these guys on the front line, they're watching every day as Russian missiles and bombs are hitting the towns and cities where their families live.
sentences.zh: 所以他们，就像其他人一样，渴望找到一种方法来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: So they, just like everyone else, are, you know, desperate to find a way to do something about this.
sentences.zh: 于是乌克兰开始了另一种无人机计划，即制造远程无人机，不是那种小型四轴无人机，

sentences.en: And so Ukraine begins another kind of drone program, which is to make long-range drones, not these small sort of little quadcopters,
sentences.zh: 而是能够飞行数百英里并携带强大爆炸载荷的无人机。

sentences.en: but drones that can fly hundreds of miles and carry powerful payloads of explosives.
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰在2022年12月首次打击了俄罗斯的一个机场。

sentences.en: So Ukraine, for the first time, strikes a Russian airfield all the way back in December 2022.
sentences.zh: 但俄罗斯显然开始适应乌克兰的这种新能力。

sentences.en: But Russia, obviously, starts to adapt to this new capability Ukraine has.
sentences.zh: 他们有强大的防空系统，但也开始采取其他措施。

sentences.en: They've got robust air defenses, but also they start taking other measures.
sentences.zh: 他们在机场的燃料库周围建造防御工事。

sentences.en: They build fortifications around fuel depots at airports.
sentences.zh: 他们建造了战斗机大小的诱饵，以迷惑乌克兰人，让他们分不清哪里是什么。

sentences.en: They build decoys at the size of fighter jets to confuse the Ukrainians as to what's where.
sentences.zh: 他们在飞机机翼上放轮胎，希望如果机场发生爆炸，弹片不会造成损害。

sentences.en: They put tires on the wings of planes in the hopes that if there is an explosion at the airport, the shrapnel doesn't do damage.
sentences.zh: 他们采取了一系列措施，总的来说，使得乌克兰人很难进行除了擦伤之外的有效打击。

sentences.en: They do a number of steps that, you know, taken together, make it exceedingly hard for the Ukrainians to strike a blow that will do more than glancing damage.
sentences.zh: 所以，解决方案还没有到位。

sentences.en: So, again, the solution isn't there yet.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以，大约一年半前，乌克兰人决定他们需要尝试一些不同的东西。

sentences.en: So, about a year and a half ago, the Ukrainians decide they need to try something different.
sentences.zh: 他们想出了这个非常秘密的计划。

sentences.en: And they come up with this very secret plan.
sentences.zh: 非常机密，乌克兰人说他们甚至没有告诉美国人。

sentences.en: So secret, the Ukrainians say they didn't even tell the Americans.
sentences.zh: 他们试图找到一种方法，将这些在前线非常有效的小型无人机带入俄罗斯，

sentences.en: They try and find a way to bring these small drones, the ones that have been so effective on the front, into Russia,
sentences.zh: 靠近这些轰炸机所在的空军基地。

sentences.en: close to these air bases where these bombers are based.
sentences.zh: 希望他们能利用这些无人机打俄罗斯人一个措手不及。

sentences.en: In the hopes that they can use them to catch the Russians by surprise.
sentences.zh: 也许至少能减缓俄罗斯的轰炸，给他们更多的战斗机会。

sentences.en: And maybe at least slow the Russian bombardments down and give them more of a fighting chance.
sentences.zh: 他们把这称为“蜘蛛网行动”。

sentences.en: And they call this Operation Spider's Web.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人制作的。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 好的，马克，带我们深入了解这次行动，“蜘蛛网行动”。

sentences.en: Okay, Mark, take us inside this operation, Operation Spider's Web.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多我们不知道的事情，我们仍在努力拼凑。

sentences.en: So, there's a lot we don't know, and we're still working to piece it together.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，这次行动非常引人注目，泽连斯基总统亲自监督了它。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that this operation was so high profile that President Zelensky himself oversaw it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它非常机密，他们甚至没有告诉美国人。

sentences.en: We know it was so secretive they didn't even tell the Americans.
sentences.zh: 我们知道目标是将这些无人机秘密运入俄罗斯并靠近这些空军基地，以便他们能击中这些轰炸机。

sentences.en: And we know the goal was to secret these drones into Russia and close to these air bases so they can hit these bombers.
sentences.zh: 所以，乌克兰要成功完成这次行动必须做两件事。

sentences.en: So, Ukraine has to do two things for this operation to be pulled off successfully.
sentences.zh: 他们必须隐藏无人机，并且必须训练无人机。

sentences.en: They have to hide the drones, and they have to train the drones.
sentences.zh: 让我们从隐藏开始。

sentences.en: And let's start with the hiding.
sentences.zh: 他们开始思考，你在路上看到的最常见、最无处不在的东西是什么？

sentences.en: They start with thinking to themselves, what is the most common, ubiquitous thing you see on the roads?
sentences.zh: 那就是集装箱，那些你每天在高速公路上看到来来往往、毫不起眼的笨重金属箱，你根本不会多想。

sentences.en: And it's shipping containers, these nondescript hulking metal boxes that you see going up and down highways every day, and you don't give a second thought.
sentences.zh: 他们决定将这些集装箱变成一种更复杂的武器输送系统。

sentences.en: They make a decision that they're going to turn those containers into a much more sophisticated weapons delivery system.
sentences.zh: 那看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: And what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 嗯，想想俄罗斯套娃，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, think of a Russian nesting doll, right?
sentences.zh: 大娃娃里面有小娃娃，还有更小的娃娃。

sentences.en: Where you have the big doll inside the big doll, there's a smaller doll and a smaller doll.
sentences.zh: 所以，你有一个可以通过遥控打开屋顶的集装箱。

sentences.en: So, you have this container with a roof that can be popped off by remote control.
sentences.zh: 但在那个集装箱里面，我们有另一个集装箱。

sentences.en: But then inside of that container, we have another container.
sentences.zh: 那个集装箱装着无人机，无人机下面是这些无人机的充电器。

sentences.en: And that container holds the drones, and beneath the drones, chargers for those drones.
sentences.zh: 那个较小集装箱的屋顶也可以打开，届时无人机可以飞向天空，一旦收到出发信号就发动攻击。

sentences.en: And the roof of that smaller container can also pop off, at which point the drones can take off into the sky and launch their attack the minute they get the signal to go.
sentences.zh: 更疯狂的是，虽然我们不确定这个拼图的每一块是在哪里组装的，但泽连斯基总统说他们设立了主要的总部，

sentences.en: And what makes it even crazier, and we're not 100% sure where each piece of this puzzle was assembled, but President Zelensky said they set up their main sort of headquarters
sentences.zh: 为了完成这次行动，就在FSB（俄罗斯联邦安全局）的街对面，

sentences.en: to pull off this operation right across the street from the FSB, which is, you know, the Russian Internal Security Services.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们是在俄罗斯境内的一个秘密基地策划这一切，据乌克兰人说，距离俄罗斯秘密警察只有一箭之遥。

sentences.en: So, they're orchestrating this whole thing from inside of Russia at a secret base that's, you know, with a stone's throw
sentences.zh: 所以，每一步都有人参与。

sentences.en: from the Russian secret police, according to the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 你有潜入俄罗斯帮助完成任务的特工。

sentences.en: So, you have people involved in every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 你有准备从乌克兰远方遥控飞行这些无人机的飞行员。

sentences.en: You have the agents who snuck into Russia to help pull this off.
sentences.zh: 每一步，都有间谍、士兵和无人机飞行员参与执行。

sentences.en: You had the pilots who were going to fly these drones from a very far remote location back in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 好的，你说第二步是训练无人机。

sentences.en: Each step along the way, you have spies and soldiers and drone pilots involved in executing this.
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的？

sentences.en: Okay, so you said step two was training the drones.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们的主要目标是这些轰炸机。

sentences.en: What did that look like?
sentences.zh: 他们想教软件如何击中这些轰炸机，以造成最大的破坏。

sentences.en: So, their primary target is going to be these bombers.
sentences.zh: 他们碰巧在乌克兰中部的一个博物馆里有一些苏联时代的轰炸机。

sentences.en: And so, they want to teach the software how to hit these bombers to do the most damage that they can.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是乌克兰还是苏联一部分的时候。

sentences.en: And they happen to have some of these Soviet-era bombers in a museum in central Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 很久以前就封存了，但事实证明在这个任务中非常有用。

sentences.en: You know, back from the day when Ukraine was a part of the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们所做的是采用一些他们在战争中一直在测试和扩展的最先进的机器学习、人工智能算法，

sentences.en: Long ago, mothballed, but turned out to be quite useful in this mission.
sentences.zh: 他们训练这些无人机去攻击这些轰炸机最脆弱的地方，也就是基本上存放燃料的地方。

sentences.en: So, what they do is they take some of the most sophisticated new machine learning, artificial intelligence algorithms that they've been testing and expanding throughout the war,
sentences.zh: 显然，这其中投入了巨大的专业技术。

sentences.en: and they train these drones to basically go after the most vulnerable spot on these bombers, which is where the fuel is kept, basically.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为克里姆林宫正在纠结的一个大问题显然是：乌克兰怎么可能渗透得如此之深、如此之久来完成这件事？

sentences.en: Just clearly an enormous amount of tradecraft went into this.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一个，我们不知道答案的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think obviously one of the big questions the Kremlin is wrestling with is how in the world could Ukraine have penetrated so deeply for so long to pull this off?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么一旦他们训练好了这些无人机，把它们藏好，它们就在国内了，下一步是什么？

sentences.en: And I think that's a, you know, we don't know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 是时候进攻了。

sentences.en: Okay, so once they have these drones trained up, they have them hidden, they're in the country, what's the next step?
sentences.zh: 周日下午1点06分左右，他们接到了命令。

sentences.en: It's time to attack.
sentences.zh: 这些集装箱的屋顶弹开，装有无人机的屋顶弹开，无人机开始升空。

sentences.en: On Sunday, around 1.06 p.m., they get the order.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始看到爆炸，烟云从机场升起，与此同时，从集装箱升起的无人机正在攻击俄罗斯各地的机场。

sentences.en: The roof of these containers pops up, the roof containing the drones pops off, and the drones start to take to the air.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始从我们的情报来源获得这些无人机在攻击任务中的直接视频画面。

sentences.en: And then we start to see explosions, clouds of smoke rising up from airfields, and at the same time, drones rising from containers are going and attacking airfields across Russia.
sentences.zh: 有一个非常引人注目的画面，你从无人机的视角看到了无人机飞行员会看到的东西，它飞过一个机场，

sentences.en: And then we start to get from our intelligence sources direct video views from these drones on their attack mission.
sentences.zh: 当时有两三架轰炸机着火了，它俯冲下去击中另一架。

sentences.en: There's one really compelling one where you see from the drone's vantage point the same thing the drone pilot would see, it flying over an airfield
sentences.zh: 有一个特别震撼的画面，你可以从无人机的视角看到无人机驾驶员所看到的一切，它飞过一个机场，

sentences.en: as two, three bombers are on fire, and it dives in to hit another one.
sentences.zh: 当时有两三架轰炸机正在起火，它俯冲下去又击中了另一架。

sentences.en: And so you start to see these just wildly dramatic images coming out, and the attack is underway.
sentences.zh: 于是你开始看到这些极其震撼的画面流出，袭击正在进行中。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've seen these videos, we've published them.
sentences.zh: 是的，我看到过这些视频，我们已经发布了它们。

sentences.en: It really starts to look at this point like a movie, like some sort of scene from Mission Impossible or something.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，这看起来真像是一部电影，就像《碟中谍》之类的场景。

sentences.en: I mean, this moment is just remarkable to watch in real time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，实时观看这一刻真是太非同寻常了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, it's really one of the kind of incredible things about this war that I don't even think we've fully understood,
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，这确实是这场战争中令人难以置信的事情之一，我认为我们甚至还没有完全理解它，

sentences.en: which is just how much of it has unfolded before the cameras.
sentences.zh: 那就是它在镜头前展现了多少内容。

sentences.en: But, you know, videos, they can lie or not tell the whole story.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，视频可能会撒谎，或者无法讲述完整的故事。

sentences.en: So our colleagues on Visual Investigations basically set to work right away to try and piece together both the videos coming from Ukrainian intelligence,
sentences.zh: 所以我们“视觉调查”部门的同事基本上立刻着手工作，试图拼凑出乌克兰情报部门提供的视频，

sentences.en: but also Russian civilians, as well as satellite images, which are still coming out, to try and understand, okay, they were able to orchestrate this attack,
sentences.zh: 同时也包括俄罗斯平民拍摄的视频，以及仍在不断流出的卫星图像，试图弄清楚，好吧，他们能够策划这次袭击，

sentences.en: but what effect did it have?
sentences.zh: 但它产生了什么效果呢？

sentences.en: And where we are now, I think, 48 hours after the attack unfolded is we can say with confidence that more than a dozen Russian bombers and planes
sentences.zh: 我想，在袭击发生48小时后的今天，我们可以自信地说，十几架俄罗斯轰炸机和飞机

sentences.en: suffered damage, quite extensive in many cases.
sentences.zh: 遭受了损坏，在许多情况下相当严重。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians say that the number could be as high as 41, and that amounts to, if the Ukrainian account is correct,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰方面称，这一数字可能高达41架，如果乌克兰的说法属实，那么这相当于

sentences.en: $7 billion in damage done by drones that cost a few thousand dollars apiece.
sentences.zh: 用每架仅值几千美元的无人机造成了70亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: Even if it's half as much as Ukraine said and it's closer to the Western estimates, that's still $3.5 billion in damage.
sentences.zh: 即使只有乌克兰所说的一半，接近西方估计的数字，那仍然是35亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: And you have to recall that this is Russia's strategic nuclear bombing fleet.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，这是俄罗斯的战略核轰炸机群。

sentences.en: So we've been talking about how Russia's been using these to launch conventional weapons at Ukraine, cruise missiles.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直在谈论俄罗斯如何利用这些飞机向乌克兰发射常规武器，即巡航导弹。

sentences.en: This is also a key element of its strategic nuclear deterrence.
sentences.zh: 这也是其战略核威慑的关键要素。

sentences.en: And Russia is not thought to have more than 100 of these, you know, totally, and they're not making any more right now.
sentences.zh: 而且据认为俄罗斯总共拥有的此类飞机不超过100架，而且他们现在已经不再生产了。

sentences.en: So the loss of 10 or 20 would itself be really significant if it's as high as the Ukrainian number.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果损失达到乌克兰所说的数字，损失10到20架本身就非常严重。

sentences.en: That's a third of that fleet.
sentences.zh: 那可是该机群的三分之一。

sentences.en: So we'll see what that tally comes to.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将看看最终的统计结果如何。

sentences.en: But, you know, undoubtedly, the attack put a big dent in the fleet.
sentences.zh: 但是，毫无疑问，这次袭击确实重创了该机群。

sentences.en: It's just remarkable to imagine these tiny, cheap little drones having that kind of an impact.
sentences.zh: 很难想象这些微小、廉价的无人机竟然能产生那样的影响。

sentences.en: But, Mark, as you've said, we've seen drones being used in this conflict for a long time now.
sentences.zh: 但是，马克，正如你所说，我们看到无人机在这场冲突中已经被使用了很长一段时间了。

sentences.en: What's different about this time?
sentences.zh: 这次有什么不同之处吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so, I mean, aside from just the boldness of this attack, it is sort of an evolution in a revolution.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，除了这次袭击的大胆程度之外，它算是一场革命中的演变。

sentences.en: And the revolution of drones, for anyone who hasn't been paying attention, I think this attack should drive that home, how it can both affect what militaries think about
sentences.zh: 对于任何没有关注过的人来说，无人机革命——我认为这次袭击应该能让人深刻体会到——它如何影响军方对

sentences.en: in terms of their force protection, what they choose to invest in.
sentences.zh: 部队保护的看法，以及他们选择投资什么。

sentences.en: It's kind of like, if you were to think about other moments in wars where a new weapon comes to life, the weapon might have existed a bit, but then it's just used to great effect.
sentences.zh: 这有点像，如果你回想战争中其他新武器问世的时刻，武器可能已经存在了一段时间，但随后被极其有效地使用。

sentences.en: So in World War II, for instance, you had the Germans using the V-1 and V-2 rockets to bombard London.
sentences.zh: 例如，在第二次世界大战中，德国人使用V-1和V-2火箭轰炸伦敦。

sentences.en: And, you know, it would be some time, but that augured in the era of the missile.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，虽然过了一段时间，但这预示着导弹时代的到来。

sentences.en: And we've seen how missiles transformed, you know, how countries fight or think about fighting or plan for fighting.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到导弹如何改变了国家作战、思考战争或规划战争的方式。

sentences.en: And I think when it comes to drones, they've been around a while.
sentences.zh: 我认为谈到无人机，它们已经存在一段时间了。

sentences.en: They've obviously, what's happened here in Ukraine is it's gotten supercharged.
sentences.zh: 显然，在乌克兰发生的事情是它被“增压”了。

sentences.en: And just the amount of adaptation and evolution that we've seen over the course of three and a half years has forced everyone who's paying attention
sentences.zh: 在三年半的时间里，我们所看到的适应和演变程度，迫使每一个关注此事的人

sentences.en: to rethink some of those doctrines that were long held about what does it take to, you know, both win on the battlefield and also, you know, to prepare for the next fight.
sentences.zh: 重新思考那些长期持有的关于如何在战场上获胜以及如何为下一场战斗做准备的理论。

sentences.en: I also feel like there's another reason this attack is really important, and that's just the timing of it.
sentences.zh: 我还觉得这次袭击之所以非常重要，还有另一个原因，那就是它的时机。

sentences.en: It comes just a few months after Trump sat with Zelensky in the Oval Office and said Ukraine was not in a good position in its negotiations with Russia over peace,
sentences.zh: 就在特朗普在椭圆形办公室与泽连斯基会面，称乌克兰在与俄罗斯的和平谈判中处于不利地位，

sentences.en: that it didn't have any cards.
sentences.zh: 没有任何筹码的几个月后，它就发生了。

sentences.en: And now Zelensky and Ukraine have orchestrated this pretty advanced attack after a long stretch where Russia was dominating the battlefield, right?
sentences.zh: 而现在，在俄罗斯长期主导战场之后，泽连斯基和乌克兰策划了这次相当先进的袭击，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like he's saying, Zelensky's saying, no, wait, we actually do have some cards.
sentences.zh: 这就像他在说，泽连斯基在说，不，等等，我们确实有一些筹码。

sentences.en: Here they are.
sentences.zh: 它们就在这里。

sentences.en: And so I'm wondering, Mark, how this affects the ongoing talks between Russia and Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，马克，这如何影响俄罗斯和乌克兰之间正在进行的谈判？

sentences.en: So first of all, you know, we talked about how this was a year and a half in the planning.
sentences.zh: 首先，你知道，我们谈到了这是筹划了一年半的行动。

sentences.en: So while President Zelensky was in the Oval Office being berated, he knew that this plot was, you know, being cooked up.
sentences.zh: 所以当泽连斯基总统在椭圆形办公室受到指责时，他知道这个阴谋正在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: So in any case, he knew he had some cards in his back pocket.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何，他知道自己的底牌里还有一些筹码。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think, you know, we talked a lot about what was Ukraine's goal with this operation, and obviously a central goal was to slow down these bombardments.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，我们谈了很多关于乌克兰这次行动的目标是什么，显然一个核心目标是减缓这些轰炸。

sentences.en: But there was a secondary goal, which was to raise the cost of this war for the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个次要目标，那就是增加克里姆林宫在这场战争中的代价。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian theory of how do you stop this war is you have to force the Russians to stop.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰关于如何结束这场战争的理论是，你必须强迫俄罗斯停止。

sentences.en: Diplomacy has so far failed.
sentences.zh: 外交迄今为止已经失败了。

sentences.en: So the only way Ukraine sees this war ending is if there is enough pressure and cost on the Kremlin to end their war.
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰认为结束这场战争的唯一途径是，如果克里姆林宫承受足够的压力和代价来结束他们的战争。

sentences.en: So this attack was a part of that.
sentences.zh: 所以这次袭击是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And then we saw today, you know, another remarkable covert operation, which was the third attack on that bridge that crosses from Crimea into Russia.
sentences.zh: 然后我们今天看到了，你知道，另一场非凡的秘密行动，也就是对那座从克里米亚通往俄罗斯的桥梁的第三次袭击。

sentences.en: Now, again, this one just happened literally, you know, this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 现在，再一次，这实际上就发生在，你知道，今天下午。

sentences.en: We don't know the damage.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道损失情况。

sentences.en: We don't know how successful it was.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它有多成功。

sentences.en: But it shows you what Ukraine's strategy here is, which is they're never going to have more people than Russia.
sentences.zh: 但这向你展示了乌克兰在这里的战略，那就是他们永远不会拥有比俄罗斯更多的人力。

sentences.en: Russia is willing to lose tens of thousands of soldiers every month.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯愿意每月损失数万名士兵。

sentences.en: Ukraine has been most successful when they've, you know, used their ability to sort of act quickly.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰最成功的时候是他们，你知道，利用了他们快速行动的能力。

sentences.en: And whether it's surprise, deception, adaptation, that's where they've had the greatest success in this war.
sentences.zh: 无论是突袭、欺骗还是适应，这都是他们在这场战争中取得最大成功的地方。

sentences.en: And so this operation, going after these Russian bombers, going after the Crimean bridge again, these play to Ukraine's strengths.
sentences.zh: 所以这次行动，针对这些俄罗斯轰炸机，再次针对克里米亚大桥，这些都发挥了乌克兰的优势。

sentences.en: At the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Putin obviously has been really resistant to pressure this whole time.
sentences.zh: 普京显然一直非常抵制压力。

sentences.en: And I have to wonder whether even with the latest successes, this has any chance of working, of forcing him to the table in a really earnest way.
sentences.zh: 我不得不怀疑，即使取得了最近的成功，这是否有任何成功的机会，能否迫使他以一种真正认真的方式回到谈判桌前。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: All I know for sure is that nobody wants peace more than Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 我唯一确定的是，没有人比乌克兰人更渴望和平。

sentences.en: They want this war to be over.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这场战争结束。

sentences.en: But none of us really know what will force Putin to stop this invasion and really either engage in good faith negotiations or agree to the immediate ceasefire that everyone,
sentences.zh: 但我们谁也不知道什么能迫使普京停止这场入侵，并真正进行真诚的谈判，或者同意每个人都想要的即时停火，

sentences.en: quite frankly,
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，

sentences.en: Ukraine, the U.S., the Europeans all want.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰、美国、欧洲人都想要。

sentences.en: And what we have instead, since this diplomatic push has sort of kicked into high gear after Trump took office, is no closer to peace, but more violent week after week.
sentences.zh: 而我们取而代之的是，自从特朗普上任后这种外交推动力进入高潮以来，和平并没有更近，反而一周比一周暴力。

sentences.en: In other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: Operation Spider's Web might end up having more of an effect on how we think about and conduct warfare in general than it will have on this actual war.
sentences.zh: “蜘蛛网行动”最终可能对我们如何思考和进行战争产生的影响，要比它对这场实际战争产生的影响更大。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you know, obviously everyone is always looking for that thing that will be the moment that turns the war or that leads to the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，你知道，显然每个人都在寻找那个能成为扭转战争或导致战争结束的时刻。

sentences.en: But the honest truth is, you know, this is total war.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，你知道，这是全面战争。

sentences.en: And in total war, it's everything together that matters.
sentences.zh: 在全面战争中，一切因素共同作用才重要。

sentences.en: So this operation will help people if it even, you know, lessens the bombardments to some degree.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这次行动哪怕能，你知道，在某种程度上减少轰炸，也会帮助人们。

sentences.en: That's thousands of people in a city or town who might not have to face a missile bombardment that otherwise would have come their way.
sentences.zh: 那意味着城市或城镇中成千上万的人可能不必面对本会降临到他们头上的导弹轰炸。

sentences.en: But yeah, at the end of the day, I think the Ukrainians are under no illusions.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，归根结底，我认为乌克兰人没有任何幻想。

sentences.en: This is their only strategy, which is to fight back, to increase the cost on the Kremlin, and just hope at some point between their own actions, their own fight,
sentences.zh: 这是他们唯一的战略，那就是反击，增加克里姆林宫的代价，并希望在某个时刻，通过他们自己的行动、他们自己的战斗，

sentences.en: and then Western support, that that pressure becomes enough where Russia decides,
sentences.zh: 以及西方的支持，这种压力变得足够大，以至于俄罗斯决定，

sentences.en: OK, enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，够了。

sentences.en: Mark, thanks for being here and stay safe.
sentences.zh: 马克，谢谢你来到这里，注意安全。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning,
sentences.zh: 周二上午，

sentences.en: Israeli soldiers opened fire near crowds of Palestinians who were walking toward a food distribution site in southern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列士兵在加沙南部向一群正走向食品分发点的巴勒斯坦人开火。

sentences.en: The Red Cross said that 27 people were killed in the attack.
sentences.zh: 红十字会表示，有27人在袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: The Israeli military said it had fired near a few people who had strayed from the designated route to the site and who didn't respond to warning shots, saying they had, quote,
sentences.zh: 以色列军方称，他们向几名偏离指定路线前往该地点且未回应警告射击的人附近开火，称他们，引用的话说，

sentences.en: posed a threat to soldiers.
sentences.zh: 对士兵构成了威胁。

sentences.en: A senior administrator at a hospital a few miles from where the shootings took place said that many of the victims were children, aged 10 to 13.
sentences.zh: 距离枪击发生地几英里的一家医院的一名高级行政人员表示，许多受害者是10到13岁的儿童。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration is proposing a deal to allow Iran to continue enriching uranium at low levels while the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府正在提议一项协议，允许伊朗继续进行低水平的铀浓缩，同时美国

sentences.en: and other countries work out a plan to eventually block
